caveats: Paper's design formula/pairing is not stated; paired fit is primary
Paper's up/down split for Old (359+572=931) does not sum to its 1,026 total; baseline 446+199=645 vs 665
Baseline Old vs Young is associational (cross-sectional), not an exercise effect
No sex covariate available in GEO metadata

Paper's reported counts (665/53/1026) most likely are the post-hoc subset of FDR<0.01 genes with log2FC beyond the direction-specific mean (FIG1 legend colours '>mean Log2 fold-change'). Applying that subset to our tables gives Young 44 (43 up/1 down SH2D3A), Old 1,301 (376/925), baseline 634 (459/175) with MLE LFC; 42/1, 386/881, 467/172 with shrunken LFC. The runner's applied counts are the plain FDR<0.01 rule (99 / 3,613 / 1,589).
Unpaired Young sensitivity fit gives 0 DEGs at FDR<0.01, so the paper's 53 Young DEGs imply a paired (subject-blocked) model.

decisions.reason: Counts from S3.1.p1 and S3.2.p1; SH2D3A is the single down-regulated gene in Young (S3.2.p1).
